items.headline: Henry Hasselbeck has 2 rushing TDs, Appalachian State beats Marshall 20-16
items.description: — Quarterback Henry Hasselbeck had two rushing touchdowns, Jaquari Lewis added 137 yards rushing on 23 carries and Appalachian State beat Marshall 20-16 on Saturday to become bowl eligible.

items.headline: Max Johnson throws 4 TD passes, adds 1 on the ground as Georgia Southern pounds Marshall 49-13
items.description: — Max Johnson threw four touchdown passes, two to Jeremiah Ware, and ran for a score as Georgia Southern rolled to a 49-13 win over Marshall on Saturday night.
